name: list-tools
description: Lists all tools in this repository by scanning tools/*/tool.json manifests. Use this first to discover available tools, their run commands, arguments, and environment variables.
use_when: discovering which tools exist or getting a compact catalogue index

args.name: --format
args.description: Output format: 'table' (human-readable), 'json' (machine-readable), or 'index' (one line per tool — the Tier-1 discovery index).

args.name: --full
args.description: Include args, env vars, and dependency details in the output.

stdout: Tool catalogue as a table, JSON array, or index lines.
